decision: Assess additional host parser and policy invariants beyond the seven retained v1 vector tests.
relationship: Supplement the frozen 2026-08-17 protocol; do not rewrite its earlier receipts or claim hardware validation.
input_method: Deterministic xorshift32 seed, generated Ethernet/single-VLAN/IPv4/TCP/UDP templates, byte mutations, arbitrary byte arrays and prefix truncations.
checks: No AddressSanitizer or UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer finding for the generated inputs.
Parser and pipeline status values remain in the declared enum.
Valid configured policies return only pass, drop or queue.
Malformed and truncated frames are dropped.
A fragmented packet never exposes valid transport ports.
Ports are exposed only for TCP or UDP.
Repeated parsing of the same input gives the same initialized view.
Fresh per-packet parse and action counters each partition one observed packet.
Parsing and classification preserve all declared input bytes.
stop_rule: Stop on the first violated invariant or sanitizer error and retain the case index, seed and input bytes for reproduction. No threshold or generator tuning after outcome selection.
toolchain_limit: A separate libFuzzer compile probe failed because the installed Windows GNU target rejects -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link. This run uses a deterministic standalone generator and does not report libFuzzer coverage.
